summary: Deployment-readiness light smoke. .gitignore fix verified: `git check-ignore -v frontend/.env backend/.env` prints nothing (rc=1); both .env files now show as untracked (??) so they can be committed; *credentials.json*, credentials.json, *token.json*, memory/test_credentials.md, *.key, *.pem are still ignored. app.json parses as valid JSON; all 4 referenced assets exist (icon 1024x1024 RGB, adaptive-icon 1024x1024 RGBA, favicon 196x196, splash-image 600x600). Backend 6/6 pytest pass (public config 200, demo OTP send channel=demo, wrong code 400, customer/driver/owner demo login + /auth/me roles). Frontend smoke at 390x844 all pass: landing brand-name 'PRAJETA' + footer-brand, /login login-brand, customer -> /customer, driver -> /driver, driver top-bar SOS opens the IN_PROGRESS trip (7068d955) even though an ACCEPTED job is listed first, owner -> /admin dashboard, deep link /admin/bookings stays on /admin/bookings. No page errors. No regressions.
action_items: Before going live: clear DEMO_PHONES / DEMO_OTP in backend env (demo phones accept 123456).
critical_code_review_comments: Expo Metro log has native-client (Expo Go) errors: "Cannot find native module 'ExpoTopicSubscriptionModule'" and "Cannot read property 'ErrorBoundary' of undefined". These come from the native device client, likely an expo-notifications/Expo Go mismatch, and do not affect web. Worth checking on a device/dev build.
The frontend env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). This is consistent and works.
context_for_next_testing_agent: /api/auth/otp/send is rate limited to 5 per phone per 10 min, so verify demo phones directly via /api/auth/otp/verify in tests. Driver 9000000002 has an ACCEPTED job (6acad2db) and an IN_PROGRESS job (7068d955). iteration_12.json was not present in /app/test_reports, so this report is numbered 13 per E1's note.
